AlternateTargets: the guest and the host in an encounter
Senses.Explanation: The paired roles of guest and host in a face-to-face encounter. Linji says that guest and host stand out distinctly and names a guest-host phrase; later public exchanges ask whether guest and host are present, how far apart they are, and whether their meeting has speech. The pair can exchange places, interpenetrate, remain mutually opposed, or be distinguished by one shout. Zhaozhou names a no-guest-no-host story, and Yuanwu says guest and host must act mutually when establishing the teaching banner. Positional compounds and Linji's named ‘four guest-and-host’ taxonomy are larger lexical objects built from the same pair. They are supporting family evidence, not additional senses of the base term.
Senses.Note: One corpus-wide sense. The former entries ‘guest and host’ and ‘guest and host (interchanging)’ paraphrased the same pair and have been merged. Interchange, distinction, negation, and public role-testing are deployments of that pair; positional compounds and the fourfold taxonomy are marked family evidence. Eight exact-headword witnesses across eight sources clear the depth gate. No master-specific second referent is attested.

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Linji Yixuan, in the Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Linji Huizhao of Zhenzhou (鎮州臨濟慧照禪師語錄), answers that guest and host stand out distinctly and names his guest-host phrase.
Occurrences.Kwic: 僧問師：「還有賓主也無？」師云：「賓主歷然。」師云：「大眾要會臨濟賓主句，問取堂中二首座。」便下座。

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Linji Yixuan's Recorded Sayings (鎮州臨濟慧照禪師語錄) place ‘guest and host stand out distinctly’ after the two halls shout together.
Occurrences.Kwic: 入，兩堂齊喝，賓主歷然。照用同時，本無前後，菱花對像，虛谷傳聲。

Occurrences.AttributionNote: The Patriarchs' Hall Collection (祖堂集) records Dongshan Liangjie asking about host-within-guest and host-within-host; these larger positional compounds support the family but lack the base headword.
Occurrences.Kwic: 洞山便問：「如何是賓中主？」云：「白雲蓋青山。」「如何是主中主？」云：「長年不出戶。」

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Guting Shanjian, in the Collected Abridgment of Chan Master Guting's Sayings (古庭禪師語錄輯略), says guest and host exchange places while bent and upright are not fixed.
Occurrences.Kwic: 賓主互換，偏正不拘，至位融和，所謂無礙。

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Eryin Mi, in the Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Eryin Mi (二隱謐禪師語錄), first states mutual opposition and then guest-host interpenetration and exchange without fixed position.
Occurrences.Kwic: 未免賓主相待，彼此回互。直須賓不是賓、賓中有主，主不是主、主中有賓，賓主交參、互換無位

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Tianyin Yuanxiu, in the Recorded Sayings of Preceptor Tianyin (天隱和尚語錄), gives a public catechism on the four guest-and-host taxonomy; the larger compound is family evidence.
Occurrences.Kwic: 「如何是主看賓？」師云：「不待形言語。」問：「如何是主看主？」師云：「兩眼對兩眼。」問：「如何是賓看賓？」師云：「二俱是瞎漢。」師復云：「離卻四賓主，諸人道將一句來看。」

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Yulin Tongxiu, in the Recorded Sayings of National Teacher Puji Yulin (普濟玉琳國師語錄), raises Master Linji's four guest-and-host taxonomy; this larger compound is family evidence.
Occurrences.Kwic: 舉臨濟大師四賓主賓看主

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Zhaozhou Congshen, as transmitted in the Collected Outlines of the Patriarchs (列祖提綱錄), tells the assembly that he has a no-guest-no-host story from a southern hearth that nobody has yet raised.
Occurrences.Kwic: 上堂，謂眾曰：我向行脚到南方火爐頭，有箇無賓主話，直至如今無人舉著。

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Juelang Daosheng, in the Complete Record of Chan Master Juelang Sheng of Tianjie (天界覺浪盛禪師全錄), answers successive public questions about whether guest and host are present, their distance, and speech when they meet.
Occurrences.Kwic: 進云：「寶鏡、寶筏還有賓主也無？」師云：「打破大散關，中間得自在。」進云：「賓主相去幾何？」師云：「此中無問答人。」進云：「賓主相見亦有言說也無？」師云：「待侍者與你三十棒。」

Occurrences.AttributionNote: In the Complete Book of the Five Lamps (五燈全書(第34卷-第120卷)), Xuean Congjin is examined face to face on how one shout distinguishes guest and host; the exchange then asks which role that shout occupies.
Occurrences.Kwic: 一日問師：一喝分賓主，照用一時行。如何是一喝分賓主？師便喝。聞曰：者一喝是賓是主？師曰：賓則始終賓，主則始終主

Occurrences.AttributionNote: Yuanwu Keqin, in the Recorded Sayings of Yuanwu Foguo (圓悟佛果禪師語錄), says establishing the teaching banner and founding the lineage require acting mutually as guest and host, then gives the seated and standing alternation.
Occurrences.Kwic: 建法幢立宗旨。須是互為賓主安貼家邦。所以道。我若坐時爾須立。我若立時爾須坐。
